items.en: What does your business idea consist of?

items.uz: Biz yosh tadbirkorlarga yordam beruvchi platforma yaratmoqchimiz.
items.en: We want to create a platform that helps young entrepreneurs.

items.uz: Bu g'oyani amalga oshirmoqlik qancha mablag' talab qiladi?
items.en: How much funding does implementing this idea require?

items.uz: Dastlabki bosqich uchun ellik ming dollar kerak.
items.en: Fifty thousand dollars are needed for the initial stage.
What will you do if funding isn't found?
We'll try to start on a smaller scale.
Is competition strong in this market?

items.uz: Ha, ammo bizning yondashuvimiz o'ziga xos.
items.en: Yes, but our approach is unique.

items.uz: Kelgusi besh yilda qanday natija kutasiz?
items.en: What results do you expect in the next five years?

items.uz: Mintaqada yetakchi kompaniyaga aylanishni maqsad qilganmiz.
items.en: We aim to become a leading company in the region.
Thank you, we hope for your cooperation.
